citation_assessments.basis: 该片段明确说明两种纤维的纤维素晶型在PFI处理中未变，且称其为相对温和的机械处理。

片段支持CI随后上升可解释为更大作用力作用于无定形区，并可能在PFI机械和热作用下干燥时发生共结晶。
片段称后续CI下降可能是结晶区持续被破坏。
片段称PFI对纤维宏观结构和性质的影响，被认为与打浆时结晶度和氢键网络变化有关。
片段明确指出纤维素结晶区含有较大比例的氢键，并据此假设PFI打浆过程中氢键网络可能变化。

basis.quote: The cellulose polymorph of these two fibers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates that the PFI refining is a relatively mild mechanical treatment
The cellulose polymorph of these two fibers had no change during PFI treatment
the CI-XI and the CI-XA of softwood fibers showed a reduction of 4.66% and 15.47%, respectively, and those of hardwood fibers decreased by 2.65% and 19.4%, respectively
The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the different regions of cellulose.
In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region.
the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining
The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.
It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].
Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.
